trace_before_dispose.rows_uow_scope: single-engine application assumption; Session and cursor hooks explicitly target installed engine
trace_before_dispose.result_scope: proxy preserves operations used by production Rows; not a general Result type substitute
trace_before_dispose.privacy: no SQL text, bindings, URL, credentials, body or exception messages
